name: Legacy CLI ASCII Table to JSON
description: Parses legacy fixed-width, bordered, or pipe-delimited CLI stdout tables into strict typed JSON records.
author: morph-os-core
llm_prompt: Convert the legacy CLI stdout table into a strict JSON array of objects using snake_case keys and inferred numeric/boolean types. Output ONLY valid JSON.
sample_input:
PID     SERVICE            STATE     MEM_MB   UPTIME_S   RESTARTS
------------------------------------------------------------------
1042    auth-gateway       RUNNING   128.4    86420      0
1188    ledger-worker      DEGRADED  512.0    14210      3
1204    legacy-cron        RUNNING   44.2     604800     0
1319    report-exporter    STOPPED   0.0      0          1
